## README.md
# Cal-Adapt Climate Projections

H3 tables derived from the Cal-Adapt Data Catalog's LOCA2-Hybrid downscaled CMIP6 projections
(UC San Diego Scripps Institution of Oceanography, California's Fifth Climate Change Assessment).
Licence CC BY 4.0; credit UC San Diego Scripps and Cal-Adapt.

| Collection | Contents |
|---|---|
| `loca2-hybrid/tasmax-exceedance` | Days per year with daily maximum temperature at or above each threshold, 20–60 °C in 0.5 °C steps |
| `loca2-hybrid/tasmax-annual-max` | Hottest day of the year (30-year average) and hottest single day |

Both are at H3 resolution 7 (parents 6 and 0), for a 1985–2014 historical baseline and SSP3-7.0
2040–2069 and 2070–2099, as the mean, min and max across three models (ACCESS-CM2, GFDL-ESM4,
MPI-ESM1-2-HR). Coverage is the full LOCA2 domain: California, Nevada and neighbouring margins.
Full documentation is in each `stac-collection.json`.

## DuckDB

```sql
INSTALL h3 FROM community; LOAD h3;

-- days per year at or above 40 °C near Sacramento, by scenario and period
SELECT scenario, period, days_mean, days_min, days_max
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-caladapt/loca2-hybrid/tasmax-exceedance/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet',
                  hive_partitioning = true)
WHERE h7 = h3_latlng_to_cell(38.58, -121.49, 7) AND threshold_c = 40.0
ORDER BY scenario, period;
```

A threshold with no row means 0 days. To join resolution-8 data, use
`h3_cell_to_parent(h8, 7) = h7`.
